name: Cranberry Salsa
subtitle: A la Kathleen
time: ~1 hr 15 min, ~20 min hands-on (mostly chilling; estimated)
notes: May add heat (jalapeños) if desired. Yummm.

items: ¾ cup sugar (or less if applesauce is sweet)

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Combine **12 oz cranberry**, chopped, **1 fuji/gala/pink lady apple**, chopped, **½ red onion**, chopped, **½ red pepper**, chopped, **3–5 Tbsp cilantro**, chopped, **½ tsp salt**, **⅓ cup unsweetened applesauce**, **¾ cup sugar** (or less if applesauce is sweet) and **1 lime**—zest and juice, and refrigerate.

yields: About 4 cups, serves about 12 as an appetizer (estimated)
